# Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI Explorer
> Alibaba Cloud's developer platform for exploring, debugging, and understanding cloud service APIs and SDKs.

This site centers on API reference, debugging tools, SDK generation, and developer resources for Alibaba Cloud services across compute, storage, networking, security, AI, and data products.

## Core Platform
- [OpenAPI Explorer](https://api.aliyun.com/): Interactive console for searching, testing, and generating requests for Alibaba Cloud APIs.
- [API Documentation](https://api.aliyun.com/document): Entry point for product API references and operation-level documentation.
- [Developer Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/): Central documentation portal for Alibaba Cloud products, guides, and references.
- [SDK Center](https://api.aliyun.com/sdk): SDK discovery and generation hub for multiple programming languages.
- [CLI Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/cli/): Documentation for Alibaba Cloud CLI installation, configuration, and command usage.

## API Reference
- [API Search](https://api.aliyun.com/product): Browse Alibaba Cloud products with available OpenAPI definitions and references.
- [API Debugging](https://api.aliyun.com/api): Test API operations with parameters, signatures, and sample requests.
- [Error Center](https://api.aliyun.com/troubleshoot): Lookup API error codes and troubleshooting information across services.
- [Change History](https://api.aliyun.com/document/ChangeLog): Track API updates, version changes, and newly released operations.
- [Endpoints](https://api.aliyun.com/meta/vpc): Example product metadata and endpoint information for service access.

## SDKs and Tools
- [Alibaba Cloud SDK Overview](https://api.aliyun.com/sdk?spm=api-workbench): Overview of available SDKs and code generation support.
- [Tea SDK Ecosystem](https://github.com/aliyun/tea): Core cross-language library model used by Alibaba Cloud SDKs.
- [Java SDK](https://github.com/aliyun/alibabacloud-java-sdk): Java SDK repository for Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI-based services.
- [Python SDK](https://github.com/aliyun/alibabacloud-python-sdk): Python SDK repository for Alibaba Cloud service integrations.
- [Go SDK](https://github.com/aliyun/alibabacloud-go-sdk): Go SDK repository for Alibaba Cloud API access.
- [Terraform Provider](https://github.com/aliyun/terraform-provider-alicloud): Infrastructure as code provider for managing Alibaba Cloud resources.

## Identity and Access
- [Resource Access Management Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/28625.html): Product documentation for users, roles, policies, and access control.
- [STS Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/28756.html): Security Token Service documentation for temporary credentials and role assumption.
- [Signature Mechanism](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/53045.html): Reference for request signing and authentication for Alibaba Cloud APIs.
- [AccessKey Management](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/38738.html): Guidance for creating, rotating, and securing AccessKey credentials.
- [RAM API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/Ram): API operations for identity, policy, and role management.

## Compute
- [Elastic Compute Service Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/25365.html): Documentation for virtual machines, disks, images, and instance lifecycle management.
- [ECS API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/Ecs): API operations for instances, networking, storage, and scaling tasks.
- [Container Service for Kubernetes Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/85222.html): Guides and references for managed Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
- [ACK API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/CS): API operations for cluster creation, scaling, and Kubernetes management.
- [Function Compute Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/50980.html): Serverless compute documentation for functions, triggers, and runtime management.
- [Function Compute API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/FC): API operations for serverless applications and function resources.

## Storage and Networking
- [Object Storage Service Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/31815.html): Documentation for buckets, objects, lifecycle rules, and access control.
- [OSS API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/Oss): API operations for object storage management and data access.
- [Virtual Private Cloud Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/44415.html): Documentation for VPCs, subnets, route tables, and private networking.
- [VPC API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/Vpc): API operations for network provisioning and connectivity management.
- [Server Load Balancer Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/27579.html): Guides for load balancing, listeners, and traffic distribution.
- [SLB API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/Slb): API operations for classic load balancer configuration and monitoring.

## Databases and Data
- [ApsaraDB RDS Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/96055.html): Documentation for managed relational databases, backups, and high availability.
- [RDS API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/Rds): API operations for database instances, accounts, backups, and configuration.
- [PolarDB Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/20415.html): Documentation for cloud-native relational database clusters and scaling.
- [PolarDB API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/polardb): API operations for cluster, account, and backup management.
- [Table Store Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/27278.html): Documentation for NoSQL wide-column storage and search capabilities.
- [OTS API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/Ots): API operations for table, index, and instance management.

## Security and Observability
- [Cloud Firewall Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/96063.html): Documentation for network security policies, traffic control, and protection.
- [Cloud Firewall API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/Cloudfw): API operations for firewall instances, rules, and assets.
- [ActionTrail Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/28832.html): Documentation for auditing account activity and API operation history.
- [ActionTrail API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/Actiontrail): API operations for trails, events, and audit delivery.
- [CloudMonitor Documentation](https://help.aliyun.com/product/28572.html): Documentation for metrics, alerts, dashboards, and monitoring integrations.
- [CloudMonitor API Reference](https://api.aliyun.com/product/Cms): API operations for alarms, metrics, and monitoring resources.

## Developer Guides
- [OpenAPI Getting Started](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121982.html): Introductory guide to calling Alibaba Cloud APIs and using OpenAPI Explorer.
- [CLI Quick Start](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/cli/getting-started/): Quick start for installing and configuring Alibaba Cloud CLI.
- [SDK Usage Guide](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29475.html): Guide to using SDKs for authenticated API requests and service integration.
- [API Error Troubleshooting](https://api.aliyun.com/troubleshoot): Searchable error code center for diagnosing API request failures.
- [Endpoint Reference](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29440.html): Reference for regional endpoints and service access domains.
- [Best Practices](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/doc-detail/2682363.html): Practical recommendations for secure and reliable API integration.

## Community and Code
- [Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI GitHub Organization](https://github.com/aliyun): Source repositories for SDKs, tools, and developer integrations.
- [OpenAPI Explorer GitHub Topics](https://github.com/topics/alibaba-cloud): Community projects and integrations related to Alibaba Cloud APIs.
- [Terraform Provider for Alibaba Cloud](https://github.com/aliyun/terraform-provider-alicloud): Official provider for provisioning Alibaba Cloud infrastructure with Terraform.
- [Alibaba Cloud CLI Repository](https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli): Source code and releases for the Alibaba Cloud command-line interface.
- [Tea OpenAPI Generator](https://github.com/aliyun/darabonba-openapi-generator): Generator tooling for producing SDKs from OpenAPI definitions.
- [Darabonba Language](https://github.com/aliyun/darabonba): Interface definition and SDK generation language used in Alibaba Cloud tooling.
